Unfortunately, no—repotting into non-Leafy soil within the first 14 days isn't covered by the Plant Care Guarantee. This exclusion exists because we can't assess whether the soil caused the issue.

However, you can still get free care advice from a Plant Care Specialist by chat or email—they may be able to help revive your ZZ plant. If it does decline significantly (losing more than a third of its leaves, stem/root rot, or collapse) after day 14, you'd be eligible for a replacement claim at that point.
